newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-S.AFRICAN PACE TRIO WRECK BOARD XI.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICAN PACE TRIO WRECK BOARD XI.

text.p: South African pace trio Fanie de Villiers, Lance Klusener and Brian McMillan combined to dismiss an Indian Board President's XI for a modest 179 on Friday.

However, the Board team hit back by reducing the South Africans to 74 for three at the close on the opening day of the three-day match, the touring side's last warm-up before the first test against India starts in Ahmedabad next Wednesday.
McMillan. who took two for 34, and Klusener, with three for 38, made the inroads before de Villiers cut down the middle and lower orders to finish with five for 46.
The Board XI slumped to 103 for eight before their score was given a measure of respectability by number 10 Salim Ankola with an aggressive 63 containing six fours and four sixes.
Ankola completed a notable personal day by removing Gary Kirsten for 11 when the South Africans began their reply.
Left-arm spinner Venkatapathy Raju, a one-time regular in the Indian test side, accounted for Andrew Hudson and captain Hansie Cronje as he produced subtle variations on a slow pitch.
